title: aria rotundifolia
intro: Aria rotundifolia, commonly known as silver tree or silver bush, is a plant species in the family Sapindaceae. It is valued for its medicinal properties, including its ability to lower blood pressure, reduce inflammation, and improve cardiovascular health. Aria rotundifolia has been used in traditional medicine to promote relaxation, reduce anxiety, and improve sleep quality.
